w10_P4_002690: The figure the port's crane supervisor ultimately needs is the total energy in kilojoules for 4 identical vessels, each unloaded by 5 identical cranes. w10_P4_002691: What the rigging foreman ultimately needs is the combined load rating in kilonewtons for 9 identical lifting beams. w10_P4_002697: The value a shipyard technician records is the corrected energy in kilojoules for a 9 shot test series, after a single 5 kJ deduction for the launch cradle. w10_P4_002702: A 23000 g test drone flies down a corridor 90 m long at a speed in metres per second equal to the rate of change of the curve 5x^3 + 5x^2 with respect to x at x = 1. w10_P4_002708: A pneumatic bottle-filling line launches a 5000 g bottle along a chute at a speed in metres per second equal to 9 times the smaller of the two values of x that satisfy x^2 - 5x + 6 = 0. w10_P4_002734: A crane on a construction site lifts a 66000 g load with an upward acceleration in metres per second squared equal to the number of ways of choosing 3 items from a set of 7.
